findings.message: Caddy's admin API has no equivalent here: ReverseDock's admin API (`admin`) is a different API, so nothing carries over
the default log's level `DEBUG` is not a configuration setting here: run `rdock run --log debug`

findings.hint: for several instances, see the cluster guide (`cluster`)
findings.message: a storage module: ReverseDock keeps certificates and state in its data directory (`RDOCK_DATA_DIR`, or `acme.storage`), not in a shared storage module
its routes are flattened into the enclosing routes, in order
handler `rate_limit` is not a standard Caddy module (a plugin) and has no equivalent
HTTP/2 server push has no equivalent (browsers removed support)

findings.message: Caddy matches paths case-insensitively: written as a case-insensitive `PathRegexp` (or `Path`/`PathPrefix` when the pattern has no letters)

findings.message: a metrics endpoint: ReverseDock serves its metrics on the admin listener (`/metrics`), not on a route

findings.hint: write `tcp_routes` and `tcp_services` (with `HostSNI` and `tls.passthrough`) or `udp_routes` by hand
findings.message: the `layer4` app (a plugin) is not migrated
Caddy's default dial timeout (3s) is written as `timeouts.connect: 3s` on each service (ReverseDock's default is 5s)
Caddy waits for a backend's answer without a time limit by default; ReverseDock's `timeouts.read` is 60s between two reads (raise it on services with slow answers)
